# ferriskey_portal_theme_page (Resource)

Manages the component tree of one page (for example `login`) of a portal theme. The API has no way to delete a page: destroying this resource resets the page to an empty tree (`[]`). If the theme is active the API rejects an empty tree for pages with required blocks; in that case destroy emits a warning and only removes the resource from state. The active theme must always keep the required blocks of each page (for example `email_input`, `password_input`, `submit_button` and `identity_providers` for `login`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_portal_theme_page" "login" {
  realm     = "acme"
  theme_id  = ferriskey_portal_theme.brand.theme_id
  page_type = "login"

  tree = jsonencode([
    { type = "email_input" },
    { type = "password_input" },
    { type = "submit_button" },
    { type = "identity_providers" },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_type` (String) Page to manage: one of `login`, `register`, `totp`, `forgot_password`, `reset_password`, `magic_link_verify`, `magic_link_request`, `verify_email`, `email_verified`, `totp_setup`, `device_verify`, `device_verified`, `consent`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the theme belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `theme_id` (String) UUID of the `ferriskey_portal_theme` owning the page. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `tree` (String) Component tree of the page as a JSON string, typically built with `jsonencode`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{theme_id}/{page_type}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_portal_theme_page.login acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666/login
```
